decisions.briefing: Markets drifted quietly lower today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.1%) with no clear directional catalyst. Cash on hand ($189.29) sits below our $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into open slots, and all 7 existing positions stay untouched to let stop-loss/profit-target rules do their job.

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 slipped modestly today, with no single headline-driving catalyst evident from available data — this looks like routine consolidation after recent moves rather than a shift in sentiment. Trading was described as neutral, meaning buyers and sellers were roughly balanced. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, it's a day for patience rather than action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克指數及標普500指數均出現小幅回落,現有資料並未顯示有明顯的單一消息面因素帶動,較像是近期升勢後的例行整固,而非市場情緒轉向。市況被形容為中性,即買賣力量大致平衡。在缺乏明確的風險偏好或避險訊號下,今天適合按兵不動、耐心觀望。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. With only $189 in cash today — below our $500 buying threshold — and no strong risk-on signal in a neutral market, holding that cash rather than forcing a trade is the disciplined move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指預留在場邊、待真正出現良好機會時才動用的現金。今天現金只有189美元,未達到500美元的買入門檻,加上市況中性、未見強烈的風險偏好訊號,因此保留現金、不勉強交易才是紀律的做法。
